notes: Purchase services chart (ST_PU_SERVICES): 12-digit codes structured by the ST_CHART_SERVICES levels; level derived, parent must exist and be unused, parent LEAF flag, delete refused for used services or services with sub-services (APP_RULES3_PR, compound trigger APP_R3_ST_PU_SERVICES_CT)

ST_PU_SERVICES.ACCOUNT_NO.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or account_number in (select p.account_number from ac_password_master p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by account_number

ST_PU_SERVICES.SERVICE_LEVEL_DESC.sql: (select max(s.chr_stru_desca) from st_chart_services s where s.chr_stru_level = t.service_level)
